# buccal
- romboid bell-shaped outline
- shorter occluso-cervically
	- relative to [[Maxillary Canine]]

![[Pasted image 20260331183904.png]]
# occlusal
- ovoid
- broader than [[Maxillary Canine]]
- more prominent buccal cusp
- mesial marginal ridge with central groove

![[Pasted image 20260331184419.png]]
**![](data:image/png;base64,)** 

**![](data:image/png;base64,)** 
# crown shape
- hexagonal
	- viewed from occlusal
# cusps
- 2 cusps
	- buccal and palatal
- palatal cusp tilts mesially
# roots
- 2 roots
	- buccal and palatal
	- sometimes 1
# ridges
- buccal triangular ridge + palatal triangular ridge
	- TRIANGULAR RIDGES
	- these ridges join --> to make ==transverse ridge==
- mesial and distal marginal ridges
# fossa
- mesial and distal triangular fossa
- central groove

MESIAL SURFACE often has mesial developmental depression
# palatal
- palatal cusp is shorter
	- more convex
		- seen from occlusal
- straightening surface near the cervical line

![[Pasted image 20260331184152.png]]

# mesial
- quadrilateral
- arrowhead fusion

![[Pasted image 20260331184348.png]]

# distal
- quadrilateral
- distal is more smaller and more regular

![[Pasted image 20260331184408.png]]


# root
- single root
	- or 2 root
- first premolar more likely to have 2 roots

![[Pasted image 20260331184534.png]]
